faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 14-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Four Years Graduate degree in Engineering, IT, or CS to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per ICMR guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Applications need to be sent via email to the address specified in the official notification before the closing date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity.

faq.question: Q9. Where is AIIMS Delhi located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Delhi is located in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110029.
